The '''Imperial Code of Military Conduct''' supervised the smooth running of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] and the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] through out the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

Article 27-A defined the lawful transfer of command of [[Gage-class transport]] should something happen to the [[Captain/Legends|captain]]; Command would transfer to the [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] along with promotion to captain.
